remaining_references.title: Built a House inside BED in Minecraft
remaining_references.narrative_spine: Revenge premise after Buu steals life savings; shrink heroes; infiltrate and establish hidden base in his bed; transfer furniture, kitchen and food; install security; Buu returns and attempts to destroy bed; reactive defenses and payback; branded outro.

scenes.label: Revenge hook and shrinking
scenes.visual: Original green and red voxel avatars in front of wooden house, shrink device, both become tiny; HUD/camera drops to tiny eye line
scenes.voice_story: They explain stolen savings, plan to live in Buu's house without being noticed, count down before shrink

scenes.label: Small entrance into giant house and inside bed
scenes.visual: Characters dig a small opening, move past furniture to oversized bed, enter abstract red interior space
scenes.voice_story: Talk through sneaking in and choosing bed as hiding place

scenes.label: Living spaces inside bed
scenes.visual: Move household furnishings, build a room and bathroom, furniture appears in bed interior
scenes.voice_story: Dialogue inventories stolen household furniture and plans living room, bathroom, useful space

scenes.label: Kitchen and farm
scenes.visual: Kitchen counter, sink, table, refrigerator, harvesting outdoor crops, farming soil and water built in red interior
scenes.voice_story: Food needs drive a farming detour, then using stolen crops to create self-sustaining garden

scenes.label: Defense preparation and window
scenes.visual: Cooling ice blocks/fans, gun-like arrow defense/sentry, green-cased reflector machines, monitoring window overlooking main bedroom
scenes.voice_story: They anticipate Buu burning the bed and attacking with projectiles/explosives, so each prepared device has an explicit later function

scenes.label: Night cut and retrieval of stolen diamonds
scenes.visual: Black NIGHT card; large main-bedroom Steve-like owner finds missing things, returns to bed, tiny protagonists enter behind bookshelf into diamond-walled stash and take valuables
scenes.voice_story: Owner announces diamonds hidden behind bookshelf; protagonists realize recovered treasure is the originally stolen property

scenes.label: Discovery and fire
scenes.visual: Owner notices abnormal bedroom, injects lava/fire into giant bed, protagonists fight flames; room temperature meter increases
scenes.voice_story: Owner recognizes intruders; protagonists activate earlier fire-contingency plan

scenes.label: Multi-step defense and retaliation
scenes.visual: Ice seals large bed chamber, ventilation machinery cools, arrow/security modules aim toward owner, owner carries rocket launcher, reflector bounces attack and large part of room explodes
scenes.voice_story: Characters activate cooling/arrow defenses, react to launcher threat, then use reflector introduced earlier to counterattack

scenes.label: Resolution and outro
scenes.visual: Surviving tiny character within giant base then 2D official Maizen endcard
scenes.voice_story: Short resolution and branded follow-up/subscribe CTA

remaining_references.title: Minecraft, But Item Drops Are Multiplied Every Time!!
remaining_references.narrative_spine: Special block multiplier introduced before adventure; wheat and basic resources explode in quantity; craft and loot through desert pyramid; exploit TNT, gold and iron; descend through cave/lava for diamonds; progress to Nether blaze/ender pearls; fight Ender Dragon with golems and staged TNT; return and outro.

scenes.label: Mechanic hook and quick resource power
scenes.visual: Original Minecraft desert village, green turtle avatar and red POV, glowing green selector, wheat/sand repeated block drops; inventory instantly full
scenes.voice_story: Characters explain special item multiplies output of blocks, immediately demonstrate and plan to gather more

scenes.label: Pyramid, TNT trap and treasure
scenes.visual: Explore desert pyramid, craft pickaxe, disarm pressure plate and recover/double TNT, loot chest items, craft iron blocks
scenes.voice_story: Plans connected by target resources; they realize TNT hazard also becomes a resource when multiplier is used

scenes.label: Mob encounter, TNT blast and deep cave
scenes.visual: Fighting mobs in desert stone rooms, TNT behind obsidian protection, burst through terrain to lava lake and stone cavern
scenes.voice_story: They turn plentiful TNT into fast mining, but must still protect themselves against explosions and lava

scenes.label: Diamonds and accelerated equipment
scenes.visual: Ore vein becomes many diamond entities, inventory/crafting tables visibly fill with resources
scenes.voice_story: Resource jackpot prompts crafting gear, upgrading from scarcity to power

scenes.label: Nether and scarce progression items
scenes.visual: Nether fortress, blaze fights, enderman and ender pearls, potion/status effects and diamond armor
scenes.voice_story: Special block multiplier does not automatically solve every non-block drop; characters must collect required End progression items

scenes.label: Ender Dragon boss strategy
scenes.visual: End dimension, Iron Golems set in place, obsidian platform and multiple stacked TNT structures, dragon health bar and successive explosions
scenes.voice_story: Heroes exploit extra blocks to build golem/TNT tactics, wait for dragon landing and keep adapting when initial attack does not finish it

scenes.label: Victory, egg and end card
scenes.visual: Dragon death visuals, dark egg on obsidian, green actor near egg, ending text about block duplicator in survival, 2D Maizen endcard
scenes.voice_story: Celebrate clearing boss and discuss dragon egg; finish with branded CTA

generalizable_lessons: Lead with a visually intelligible high-concept rule or unresolved wrong done within first ~30 seconds
Maintain two contrasting character voices and cause-effect dialogue that tells audiences why choices/actions matter
Use a modular world and consistent props/world states, not random unscripted play alone
Show progress through visibly changing in-game inventory, space, threat or discoveries
Schedule callbacks: early props and construction plans must be tested by later conflicts
Lengthen and diversify the climax rather than repeating the hook without evolution
Separate game-camera and staged reaction coverage; license original sounds, assets and names
Never infer proprietary mod versions/Blender/recording bots from the image or captions alone

production_studio_handoffs.RESEARCH: Three format DNA profiles should be compared with more episodes per format; screenshot sampling is not every frame; audio ASR not full Foley/music validation
production_studio_handoffs.WRITERS_ROOM: Choose one original dramatic mechanism for MAI01; opening claim, protagonist mistaken assumption, escalating consequences, planted tool used in ending
production_studio_handoffs.PRODUCTION_DESIGN: For tiny-home stories maintain 3D scale consistency; for progression format implement resource-item invariants; for pairwise format maintain adjacent challenge stages
production_studio_handoffs.PERFORMANCE: Block distinct two-actor camera eyelines, responses, inventory/hand interactions; no reuse of copyrighted characters
production_studio_handoffs.TECHNICAL_DIRECTION: Benchmark a real first-party shot among licensed game staging / authored Blender CGI / hybrid; do not claim exact Maizen backend
production_studio_handoffs.AUDIO_EDITORIAL: Use narrative speech and objective SFX cues synchronized to filmed actions, verify source-music rights; end-card has independent 2D art
production_studio_handoffs.QC: Require real motion, visual scene continuity, original sound speech/SFX/music checks and an independent reviewer before source G02 certification
